text:
emma-sales: Quick sync — FinEdge (SOX/PCI) asked for an air-gapped POC using their SafeVault HSM and Redwood Private. They want: preflight checklist, an example integration test vector we can run offline, and confirmation on how billing works when HSM is customer-provided. Also the security questionnaire flagged automated rotation windows. Can someone own the preflight doc + test vector?

gideon-crypto: I can draft the crypto preflight. High-level asks: 1) key import vs. wrapped key flow? 2) do they require deterministic attestations from SafeVault? 3) rotation cadence (daily/weekly) and whether they want automatic rewrap by Redwood or manual ceremony.

emma-sales: They prefer importing wrapped keys (they control KEKs). They asked for manual ceremony but are open to an automated option with approval flow. Attestations: SafeVault can produce signed device attestations (x509) during import. Rotation cadence TBD — finance leaning toward monthly.

nate-ops-engineer: For Private air-gapped we need network preflight: 1) serial console access during install, 2) SFTP for model artifacts, 3) jumpbox IP allowlist for admin. For HSM integration we need the PKCS#11 endpoint + tooling and an offline test vector to validate: `sign/verify` and `wrap/unwrap` using a sample payload.

gideon-crypto: Drafting a minimal testvector below — run locally against their HSM emulator or SafeVault device. Replace placeholders with their slot/pin and path to module.

gideon-crypto: ```
# TEST VECTOR: sign + verify (SHA256)
# 1) generate sample payload
echo -n "redwood-test-123" > payload.bin
# 2) sign using PKCS11 (example CLI)
pkcs11-tool --module /opt/safevault/libpv.so -l --pin 1234 -y privkey -s SHA256 -i payload.bin -o sig.bin
# 3) verify using public key (OpenSSL)
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature sig.bin payload.bin
# Expected: "Verified OK"
```

gideon-crypto: And a wrap/unwrap vector: ```
# WRAP/UNWRAP: AES-KWP with HSM KEK
echo -n "16-bytes-key----" > cek.bin
# wrap
pkcs11-tool --module /opt/safevault/libpv.so -l --pin 1234 --wrap-key --key-type AES:128 --id 02 --label KEK -i cek.bin -o cek.wrapped
# unwrap (on Redwood side during POC)
pkcs11-tool --module /opt/safewood_redwood_stub.so --unwrap --id 02 --pin redwood-pin -i cek.wrapped -o cek.unwrapped
# verify cek.unwrapped == cek.bin
```

emma-sales: Perfect — can you add expected failure modes (bad PIN, missing slots, attestation mismatch) so SEs know how to interpret errors? Also need a preflight checklist for legal/infosec: attestation verification steps, backup key escrow requirements, and rotation approval log.

gideon-crypto: Adding quick failure notes: 1) Bad PIN -> HSM returns PKCS11 CKR_PIN_INCORRECT. 2) Missing slot -> `CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID`. 3) Attestation mismatch -> cert chain fail; recommend a step to verify trust anchor thumbprint (sha256). I'll append those to the checklist.

paul-legal: For contracting — we need clarity on where custody changes. If FinEdge controls KEKs and we only hold wrapped CEKs during runtime, we need an explicit clause: "Redwood will not have access to unwrapped customer KEKs or CEKs outside ephemeral in-memory cache" plus audit logging SLA (retain import/unwrap events for 1 year). Also need SOC2 attestation from SafeVault if they assert FIPS/HSM claims.

emma-sales: Noted. Paul — can you confirm a short paragraph we can present to customer about custody and log retention? They asked in the questionnaire.

paul-legal: I'll drop a paragraph: "Customer-managed KEKs: customer retains sole control of Key Encryption Keys (KEKs). Redwood will accept wrapped CEKs and will perform in-memory unwrap only for active sessions; unwrapped keys are never persisted. All unwrap/import operations are logged and retained for 12 months. Customer must provide HSM attestation artifacts; Redwood requires vendor SOC2 + FIPS validation docs for production onboarding." Use that under the "Key Custody" question.

nate-ops-engineer: Ops note on billing: For Dedicated + Private air-gapped POC we charge a one-time on-site install fee (SOW), monthly Private node fee (reserved), and we do not bill for customer's HSM hardware. If they want Redwood-managed wrap/rotation tooling (optional) that includes monthly automation surcharge. I'll confirm numbers in the quote but the pricing model is: SOW install + reserved infra + optional managed-key add-on.

emma-sales: Good. Next actions: 1) Gideon — finalize preflight checklist + testvectors and include failure codes (ETA EOD PST). 2) Nate — draft pricing bullets + install SOW line items. 3) Paul — short custody paragraph for the questionnaire. I'll package into the POC packet and send to FinEdge tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed snippet to /confluence/poCs/finedge-airgap-preflight v1.0 (read-only).

emma-sales: Thanks all. I'll ping with the customer meeting time once I have their preferred window.
